decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposal would constitute unacceptable backland development, out of keeping with the existing pattern of development and would be harmful to the character and appearance of the area. The proposal would result in harm to neighbours' living conditions through loss of open aspect and outlook.

Condition : 2 - The proposal would provide unsatisfactory living accomodation contrary to Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines) and H.6.3 (Backland Development/Infill Development) of The London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan, Adopted December 2003, and Sections 1 (Design and Layout), 9 (Form and Design) and 10 (Private amenity Space) of associated Supplementary Planning Guidance (February 1997).

Condition : 3 - The proposed vehicular access and the proposed replacement parking space for number 39 Walnut tree Road are unacceptable in that they would represent a safety hazard for pedestrians, particularly people entering and leaving the front door of number 39 due to a lack of pedestrian and vehicle separation, poor visibility and inadequate manoeuvring area contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan Polices T.1.4 and T.4.4.
description: Erection of a detached bungalow with associated parking and landscaping.
